title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
description: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy is an action-adventure prequel set fifteen years before the events of A Plague Tale: Requiem. Players take control of Sophia as she journeys to the mysterious Minotaur's Island, combining combat, exploration, environmental puzzles, and narrative-driven storytelling. The gameplay showcased on SPCBM is captured in real time using Ultra graphics settings at 4K, demonstrating the visual fidelity and performance of a modern high-end PC experience.
